technology_name: Nutrient Enriched Pasta from Orange-Fleshed Sweet Potato
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
description: Orange-fleshed sweet potato is rich in β-Carotene, a precursor of Vitamin A. High carotene content can help to combat Vitamin A deficiency.Pasta made from orange fleshed sweet potato which has high β-carotene and lysine content compared to wheat pasta, good swelling index after cooking, and a high amount of resistant Starch.
applications:
Functional and fortified food manufacturing companies
Nutraceutical and health food product enterprises
Sweet potato processing and value-addition industries
School nutrition, public health, and food supplementation programs
Healthcare nutrition providers and institutional catering services
